analyses.question: Show monthly orders and average review score together for 2017
assumptions: Year 2017 resolved to 2017-01-01 through 2017-12-31
Both tools use the same delivered-order cohort so orders and review scores share one comparable month axis
Review scores are canonical (one per order, deduplicated by latest answer timestamp)

analyses.insight: Monthly delivered orders peaked in November 2017 at 7,289 orders, when the average review score was 3.99 stars.

analyses.question: Show delivery delay and review score side by side by state
assumptions: No date range was specified, so the full Olist dataset was used.
State means the customer (destination) state in both tools
Matching cohort: delivered orders for both delay and review score
Review scores are canonical (one per order, deduplicated by latest answer timestamp)
analyses.chartReason: Bar chart used because fallback mode is intentionally limited to bar visualizations. Delay (days) and review score (stars) are shown in separate bar panels with separate scales; they are never combined on one shared axis.
analyses.insight: Average delivery delay was highest in AL at -8 days, where the average review score was 3.85 stars.
